name: A_basic
description: The basic agent (vm-00006): a single world, one agent. The model reads its last 8 real states (frame, drives, previous move) and predicts the next one: the next move, and the next frame and drives given that move. It makes the predicted move and, every step, learns from what actually happened (one window of the last 8 steps). No planning, no latent world model, no inverse dynamics, no replay, no reward.
